name: zerodom
description: Token-optimized interaction graph for AI browser agents — 71% fewer tokens than ARIA snapshots.
long_description: ZeroDOM parses a live page into a flat, addressable list of clickable/fillable nodes (`[03] button 'Sign In'`) instead of an accessibility tree or raw DOM dump. Every CSS selector it returns is checked for actual document-wide uniqueness before being trusted, not assumed from an attribute — 99.00% of 10,756 audited selectors across 111 real sites resolve to exactly one element. Requires Playwright's Chromium to be installed once (`uvx --from zerodom playwright install chromium`) before first use.
